cat > /tmp/opencode/ds_mst_ui.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time

DRIVE = ["python3", "qa/drive.py", "--port", os.environ.get("PORT") or os.environ.get("MST_QA_PORT", "8879"),
         "--display", os.environ.get("DISPLAY", ":79")]


def run(*a):
    return subprocess.run(DRIVE + [str(x) for x in a], cwd=os.environ.get("ROOT", "."),
                          capture_output=True, text=True)


def dump():
    p = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".json")
    r = run("ui", "--filter", "", "--save", p)
    if r.returncode:
        sys.exit("ui failed: " + r.stderr[-300:])
    d = json.load(open(p)); os.unlink(p)
    return [c for c in d["controls"] if c.get("rect") and c["rect"][2] > 0 and c["rect"][3] > 0 and c.get("visible")]


def find(name, classes=None):
    cs = dump()
    if classes:
        cs = [c for c in cs if c.get("class") in classes]
    hits = [c for c in cs if c.get("name") == name] or [c for c in cs if c.get("text") == name]
    if not hits:
        sys.exit("control not found: " + name)
    return hits[0]


def center(c):
    x, y, w, h = c["rect"]
    return int(x + w / 2), int(y + h / 2)


def path(p):
    return p if os.path.isabs(p) else os.path.join(os.environ.get("OUT", "."), p)


def project(pt):
    o = run("project", "--point", json.dumps(pt)).stdout
    try:
        d = json.loads(o)
    except Exception:
        sys.exit("project failed: " + o[-200:])
    pts = d.get("points") or []
    if not pts:
        sys.exit("project: no point")
    return pts[0]["window"]


cmd = sys.argv[1]
if cmd == "crop":
    from PIL import Image
    out, name = path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
    pads = [int(v) for v in sys.argv[4:8]]
    c = find(name); x, y, w, h = c["rect"]
    tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".png"); run("capture", tmp)
    img = Image.open(tmp)
    rect = (max(0, x - pads[0]), max(0, y - pads[2]), min(img.width, x + w + pads[1]), min(img.height, y + h + pads[3]))
    img.crop(rect).save(out); os.unlink(tmp); print(out, rect)
elif cmd == "croppopup":
    from PIL import Image
    out = path(sys.argv[2]); pad = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 12
    pp = run("popups"); pop = json.loads(pp.stdout)["popups"][0]
    x, y = pop["pos"]; w, h = pop["size"]
    tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".png"); run("capture", tmp)
    img = Image.open(tmp)
    rect = (max(0, x - pad), max(0, y - pad), min(img.width, x + w + pad), min(img.height, y + h + pad))
    img.crop(rect).save(out); os.unlink(tmp); print(out, rect)
elif cmd == "cropwin":
    from PIL import Image
    out = path(sys.argv[2]); x, y, w, h = [int(v) for v in sys.argv[3:7]]
    tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".png"); run("capture", tmp)
    Image.open(tmp).crop((x, y, x + w, y + h)).save(out); os.unlink(tmp); print(out)
elif cmd == "cropat":
    from PIL import Image
    out = path(sys.argv[2]); pt = [float(v) for v in sys.argv[3:6]]
    w, h = int(sys.argv[6]), int(sys.argv[7])
    x, y = project(pt)
    tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".png"); run("capture", tmp)
    img = Image.open(tmp)
    left = int(max(0, min(img.width - w, x - w / 2)))
    top = int(max(0, min(img.height - h, y - h / 2)))
    img.crop((left, top, left + w, top + h)).save(out); os.unlink(tmp); print(out, (left, top, w, h))
elif cmd == "full":
    out = path(sys.argv[2]); tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".png"); run("capture", tmp)
    os.replace(tmp, out); print(out)
elif cmd == "clickpoint":
    pt = [float(v) for v in sys.argv[2:5]]
    x, y = project(pt)
    args = ["click", int(x), int(y)]
    rest = sys.argv[5:]
    print(run(*(args + rest)).stdout[-100:])
elif cmd == "topview":
    cs = dump()
    cand = [c for c in cs if c.get("class") == "MenuButton" and 165 <= c["rect"][1] <= 215
            and c["rect"][2] >= 100 and 380 <= c["rect"][0] <= 700]
    if not cand:
        sys.exit("topview: no view menu")
    c = min(cand, key=lambda c: c["rect"][1])
    x, y = center(c)
    pops = []
    for _ in range(4):
        run("click", x, y); time.sleep(1.0)
        p = run("popups")
        pops = json.loads(p.stdout).get("popups", [])
        if pops:
            break
        time.sleep(0.8)
    if not pops:
        sys.exit("topview: no popup")
    pop = pops[0]
    for k, it in enumerate(pop["items"]):
        if it.get("text") == "Top View":
            px, py = pop["pos"]
            ih = pop["size"][1] / max(len(pop["items"]), 1)
            run("click", px + 40, int(py + ih * (k + 0.5))); time.sleep(0.8)
            print("topview ok")
            break
    else:
        sys.exit("topview: item not found")
elif cmd == "menupick":
    x, y, text = int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4]
    run("click", x, y); time.sleep(0.8)
    p = run("popups")
    pops = json.loads(p.stdout).get("popups", [])
    if not pops:
        sys.exit("menupick: no popup")
    for it in pops[0]["items"]:
        if it.get("text") == text:
            ix, iy, iw, ih = it["rect"]
            run("click", int(ix + iw / 2), int(iy + ih / 2)); time.sleep(0.6)
            print("menupick", text)
            break
    else:
        sys.exit("menupick: item not found " + text)
elif cmd == "recat":
    from PIL import Image
    out = path(sys.argv[2]); pt = [float(v) for v in sys.argv[3:6]]
    w, h = int(sys.argv[6]), int(sys.argv[7])
    fps = sys.argv[8] if len(sys.argv) > 8 else "12"
    mx = sys.argv[9] if len(sys.argv) > 9 else "20"
    x, y = project(pt)
    left = int(max(0, min(1920 - w, x - w / 2)))
    top = int(max(0, min(1080 - h, y - h / 2)))
    r = subprocess.run(["qa/record.sh", "start", out, "--display", os.environ.get("DISPLAY", ":79"),
                        "--rect", f"{left},{top},{w},{h}", "--fps", fps, "--max", mx],
                       cwd=os.environ.get("ROOT", "."), capture_output=True, text=True)
    print("recat", left, top, w, h, r.returncode, r.stderr[-120:])
elif cmd == "movepoint":
    pt = [float(v) for v in sys.argv[2:5]]
    x, y = project(pt)
    print(run("move", int(x), int(y)).stdout[-80:])
elif cmd == "find":
    c = find(sys.argv[2]); print(json.dumps(c, indent=1))
elif cmd == "popick":
    x, y, idx = int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4])
    run("click", x, y); time.sleep(0.8)
    p = run("popups")
    pops = json.loads(p.stdout).get("popups", [])
    if not pops:
        sys.exit("popick: no popup")
    pop = pops[0]; px, py = pop["pos"]
    ih = pop["size"][1] / max(len(pop["items"]), 1)
    run("click", px + 30, int(py + ih * (idx + 0.5))); time.sleep(0.5)
    print("popick", idx)
elif cmd == "setat":
    x, y, val = int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4]
    run("click", x, y); time.sleep(0.4)
    run("key", "a", "--ctrl"); run("type", val); run("key", "enter"); time.sleep(0.5)
    print("setat", x, y, val)
else:
    name = sys.argv[2]
    cls = {"option": ("OptionButton",), "slider": ("HSlider",), "spin": ("EditorSpinSlider",),
           "check": ("CheckBox",)}.get(cmd)
    c = find(name, cls)
    if cmd == "click":
        print(run("click", *center(c)).stdout[-100:])
    elif cmd == "check":
        want = sys.argv[3].lower() in ("1", "on", "true", "yes")
        if bool(c.get("toggled")) != want:
            run("click", *center(c)); time.sleep(0.3)
        print(name, "->", want)
    elif cmd == "spin":
        x, y = center(c)
        run("click", x, y); time.sleep(0.4)
        run("key", "a", "--ctrl"); run("type", sys.argv[3]); run("key", "enter"); time.sleep(0.4)
        print(name, ":=", sys.argv[3])
    elif cmd == "slider":
        frac = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(sys.argv[3]))); x, y, w, h = c["rect"]
        tx = int(x + 2 + frac * (w - 4)); yy = int(y + h / 2)
        run("drag", tx - 1, yy, tx + 1, yy, "--duration", "0.2"); time.sleep(0.4)
        print(name, "->", frac)
    elif cmd == "option":
        idx = int(sys.argv[3]); run("click", *center(c)); time.sleep(0.8)
        p = run("popups")
        pops = json.loads(p.stdout).get("popups", [])
        if not pops:
            sys.exit("option: no popup opened for " + name)
        pop = pops[0]; px, py = pop["pos"]
        ih = pop["size"][1] / max(len(pop["items"]), 1)
        run("click", px + 30, int(py + ih * (idx + 0.5))); time.sleep(0.5)
        print(name, "->", idx)

PYEOF
